premise: Loping home in the long night, the crew rover's lights find one bootprint by the lander: Leo's very first step on the Moon, months ago, as sharp as the day he made it.
inspiration: Grimm's 'Hansel and Gretel' and their pebble trail, turned: the trail is your own first step, and nothing has blown it away.
learning: Footprints on the Moon last for ages, because no wind or rain wipes them away.

en-US.title: Leo's First Footprint
en-US.text: {canvas:nightfall} It was the middle of the long Moon night. {man:enter} Leo and {woman:enter} Maya were loping home, and the big {crew-rover:enter} crew rover rolled along beside them. {crew-rover:live hold} {sfx:lights} It switched on its headlights to light the way. The beams swept across the landing pad, over the {lander:enter} {lander:go to pad} lander… and stopped. {man:face surprised} {man:says} [excited] “Wait! Look at that!” He {man:go to lander} bounded over. By the lander's foot was a single bootprint, crisp and sharp. {lander:pulse} {man:says} [in awe] “It's mine. My very first step on the Moon.” {woman:face surprised} {woman:wobble} {woman:says} “But that was months ago!” {man:live} Leo checked his wrist display and nodded. Months ago, and not one speck had moved. {woman:shake 0.3} No wind on the Moon. No rain. Nothing to wipe a footprint away. {woman:face happy} {woman:says} [playfully] “So it'll still be here when you're a grandpa.” {canvas:floodlights} The base's floodlights flicked on to welcome them home, {man:face happy} {man:hearts} and Leo grinned all the way back.

es-ES.title: La primera huella de Leo
es-ES.text: {canvas:nightfall} Era la mitad de la larga noche lunar. {man:enter} Leo y {woman:enter} Maya volvían a casa dando saltos, y el gran {crew-rover:enter} rover de tripulación rodaba a su lado. {crew-rover:live hold} {sfx:lights} Encendió los faros para alumbrar el camino. La luz recorrió la plataforma de aterrizaje, pasó por el {lander:enter} {lander:go to pad} módulo lunar… y se detuvo. {man:face surprised} {man:says} [excited] «¡Espera! ¡Mira eso!» Fue {man:go to lander} dando saltos. Junto a la pata del módulo había una sola huella de bota, nítida y perfecta. {lander:pulse} {man:says} [in awe] «Es mía. Mi primer paso en la Luna.» {woman:face surprised} {woman:wobble} {woman:says} «¡Pero si eso fue hace meses!» {man:live} Leo miró la pantalla de su muñeca y asintió. Hacía meses, y no se había movido ni una mota. {woman:shake 0.3} En la Luna no hay viento. Ni lluvia. Nada que borre una huella. {woman:face happy} {woman:says} [playfully] «Así que seguirá aquí cuando seas abuelo.» {canvas:floodlights} Los focos de la base se encendieron para recibirlos, {man:face happy} {man:hearts} y Leo sonrió todo el camino de vuelta.
